Prior art is already registered as four LANDMINES.md entries (~2005, ~2501, ~4567, ~4760) and this is the FOURTH recorded occurrence — the 2026-07-31 entry already concluded "the durable fix is not putting checkouts in tmpfs", correctly, and that conclusion never reached the nine documents prescribing it.
